states.definition: Corroborated directly by a Tier 1 authoritative publisher (Government, Statutory Regulator).
Corroborated by a Tier 2 issuer disclosure (SEDAR+, official annual report) or multiple independent Tier 3 news reports.
Reported by a single source without independent statutory verification.
Derived algorithmically via deterministic dependency ontologies or graph traversals.
Multiple active sources assert mutually irreconcilable factual statements.
Data point is unobserved or not disclosed in public record.
Information has exceeded its review horizon without recent reconfirmation.
Source publication or claim has been formally withdrawn by the publisher.
